title: Shared definitions
description: Types shared by every Spirit Island data collection.

id.description: Stable, url-safe identifier: a lowercase kebab-case slug of the entity's name. Never changes once published.

scopedId.description: Identifier of an entity owned by another, prefixed with its owner's id, e.g. 'shadows-flicker-like-flame/madness'.

sickSlug.description: Image filename (without extension) of a card on SICK (https://sick.oberien.de), which also serves as the card's lookup key in the bot.

text.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace.

emote.description: A Discord custom emoji (<:Name:id>) or a unicode emoji.

aliases.description: Alternative search terms: nicknames, abbreviations, emoji or lore names.

panel.description: Image urls for the faces of a card or panel, front first.

doubleSidedPanel.description: Image urls for the front and back of a double-sided card or panel.

setCode.description: Product the entity was released in: base game, Branch & Claw, Feather & Flame, Jagged Earth, Horizons of Spirit Island or Nature Incarnate.
